name: logic-syllogism
objective: All department heads attend the Monday meeting. Ayse is a department head. Does Ayse attend the Monday meeting?
output_contract: Yes/No answer with a one-line logical justification.

candidates.A: It cannot be determined from the given statements whether Ayse attends.
candidates.B: No — being a department head does not imply attending the meeting.
candidates.C: Yes — all department heads attend, Ayse is a department head, therefore Ayse attends.
